sentences.en: I will give you back the CD in a week.
sentences.zh: 我一个星期后会把这张光盘还给你。

sentences.en: Will you lend me your CD player for an hour?
sentences.zh: 你能不能借我把你的随身听用一个小时？

sentences.en: She put her CDs in a row on the shelf.
sentences.zh: 她把CD整齐地摆在书架上。
